title: RuneScape's fantasy world may become an animated series
summary:
The fantasy world of RuneScape is being developed into an animated series. Lyrical Animation is working on the project with game developer Jagex and online creator Charlie White.

Jagex chief executive Jon Bellamy announced the project on Saturday at RuneFest in Birmingham, in the United Kingdom. The series would bring the game's world, called Gielinor, to the screen.

RuneScape first came out in 2001. It is an online role-playing game, where players take on characters and share adventures with others. They can explore, complete quests and cooperate in a medieval fantasy setting. A quest is a task or adventure within a game's story.

White said he has played RuneScape for 22 years and that it is one of his favorite fictional worlds. His company, Meatier Productions, will help produce the animation alongside Lyrical Animation.

Bellamy hopes to reach both existing fans and people who have never played the games. Lyrical's creative director, Daniel Dominguez, praised RuneScape's mix of humor and thoughtful storytelling.

Development is still at an early stage. The company expects to share more details in 2027.
why_it_matters: The project could let people explore RuneScape's stories through animation, including viewers who have never played the game.
